articles.summary: Benzinga: Severe Winter Storm Grounds Thousands Of Flights, Triggers Emergency Declarations. A severe winter storm has led to the cancellation of thousands of flights across the United States, affecting travelers nationwide. Over 9,500 Flights Canceled According to data from FlightAware, over 9,500 flights were canceled across the U.S. due to the severe winter storm.
